bd-foh8.2 CLOSED. Commit 0e65d38 on main.

EVIDENCE:
- 9 new gate tests in crates/toron-core/src/mailbox/reservations.rs: intent declare+board, acquire-vs-intent = SOFT not hard, held hard-blocks unchanged, clear acquire immediate, TTL expiry unblocks acquire, must-convert (own acquire supersedes intent), tiered report (hard+soft), request-release roundtrip + validations (self/unknown-id/wrong-holder), status Pending->EscalationDue + captain DM, response resolution (latest-wins, deferred round-trip, third-party denied), operator gate.
- toron-core 362P/0F/1I; toron-mcp 36P+5P+7P+1P; e2e all green; clippy -D warnings clean on touched files.
- MCP: AcquireResult/ConflictReport gain ADDITIVE soft_conflicts/has_soft_conflicts keys (ToJson + Out schema). NO new MCP tools, NO arg changes (ADR-0011 forbidden zone + C3 respected).

WHAT LANDED (ADR-0011 Spec 2/4/6, pure toron-core/mailbox):
- 30031 status state machine (Held|Intent|Released|Revoked); status-less = held, backward compat. resolved_leases = one replay for held view / intent board / conflict view.
- declare_intent() -> active_intents() board; intent TTL 300s default (NIP-40 + declared+TTL cap); must-convert via own acquire.
- Soft-conflict check: acquire against in-TTL intent = freeze (soft_conflicts, NOT hard block); held = hard block unchanged; no conflict = immediate grant.
- Request-release ladder: request_release -> respond_request_release -> request_release_status (Pending|Responded|EscalationDue) -> escalate_request_release (kind-14 DM to captain=operator). Force-release untouched (operator last resort).

@RoseDune @CoralFinch: my file reservations (reservations.rs, mcp tools/mod.rs + responses.rs) RELEASED — cargo/test slot free. Pre-existing clippy debt NOT mine: toron-core config/mod.rs doc-lint errors (187-189, 229-234).
